cases.sentence: И вот только у Карачарова мой ___ расслышал и внял.
cases.translation: And only at Karacharovo did my God finally hear me and heed me.
cases.explain: The word is the subject of the verbs «расслышал и внял», and the subject of a sentence stands in the nominative.

cases.sentence: И умолял ___ моего не обижать меня.
cases.translation: And I begged my God not to hurt me.
cases.explain: «Умолять» takes a direct object in the accusative; Бог is animate, so its accusative copies the genitive form Бога.

cases.sentence: Так и метался в четырех ___, ухватив себя за горло.
cases.translation: So I thrashed about within four walls, gripping myself by the throat.
cases.explain: «В» answering «где?» (a location, not a direction) requires the prepositional: в стенах.

cases.sentence: Метался в четырех стенах, ухватив себя за ___.
cases.translation: I thrashed about within four walls, having grabbed myself by the throat.
cases.explain: «За» in the sense of seizing hold of a body part governs the accusative; горло is neuter and inanimate, so the accusative looks like the nominative.

cases.sentence: Было бы некрасиво возвращать ___ ее дары.
cases.translation: It would be ugly to give nature back her gifts.
cases.explain: «Возвращать» takes the recipient in the dative — you return something TO someone: возвращать природе.

cases.sentence: Полное отсутствие всякого ___ – но зато какая мощь!
cases.translation: A complete absence of any meaning — but what power!
cases.explain: The noun «отсутствие» (absence of something) is followed by the genitive, and «всякого» agrees with it.

cases.sentence: Кувыркался из угла в угол с ___ на горле.
cases.translation: I tumbled from corner to corner with a hand on my throat.
cases.explain: «С» meaning 'together with / accompanied by' governs the instrumental; рукою is the older variant of рукой.

cases.sentence: Пьют с сознанием собственного превосходства над ___.
cases.translation: They drink with a sense of their own superiority over the world.
cases.explain: The preposition «над» always governs the instrumental case: над миром.

reading.question: What was Venichka doing all the way from Serp i Molot to Karacharovo?
options: Counting up what he had spent
reading.explain: The glass he had drunk kept rising and falling inside him, and all he could do was suffer and pray.

reading.ru: Это было как Везувий, Геркуланум и Помпея, как первомайский салют в столице моей страны.
reading.question: What does Venichka compare the churning inside him to?
options: Vesuvius, Herculaneum and Pompeii, and a May Day salute
The bells of a village church
A train pulling out of Kursk station
reading.correct: Vesuvius, Herculaneum and Pompeii, and a May Day salute
reading.explain: He reaches for a volcanic eruption and a holiday firework salute to describe the upheaval in his stomach.

reading.ru: И вот только у Карачарова мой Бог расслышал и внял.
reading.question: At which station did Venichka's God finally hear his plea?
reading.explain: Only at Karacharovo did everything settle down and go quiet inside him.

reading.ru: Я уважаю природу, было бы некрасиво возвращать природе ее дары…
reading.question: What reason does Venichka give for keeping the drink down?
options: He respects nature, and giving her gifts back would be ugly
A fellow passenger talked him out of it
He had in fact drunk nothing at all
reading.correct: He respects nature, and giving her gifts back would be ugly
reading.explain: He says that once something in him settles it is settled for good, and adds this half-joking principle about nature's gifts.

reading.ru: Я кое-как пригладил волосы и вернулся в вагон.
reading.question: What did Venichka do just before going back into the carriage?
options: Smoothed down his hair as best he could
Wrote the incident down in a notebook
Opened a window to get some air
reading.correct: Smoothed down his hair as best he could
reading.explain: He tidies his hair after his struggle on the platform and returns to his seat.

reading.ru: Мне нравится, что у народа моей страны глаза такие пустые и выпуклые.
reading.question: What does Venichka say he likes about the eyes of the people of his country?
options: That they are so empty and bulging
That they are sharp and watchful
That they are full of hidden meaning
reading.correct: That they are so empty and bulging
reading.explain: The empty, protruding gaze of the passengers fills him with a feeling of legitimate pride.

reading.ru: Ничего не продадут и ничего не купят.
reading.question: What does Venichka claim these eyes will never do?
options: Look a stranger in the face
reading.explain: He contrasts them with the hunted, greedy eyes of the world of hard cash, where everything is bought and sold.

reading.ru: Может, я играл в бессмертную драму «Отелло, мавр венецианский»?
reading.question: How does Venichka excuse his behaviour out on the platform?
options: By suggesting he was performing Othello, playing every part himself
By saying he had been fixing the carriage door
By saying he had been looking for his suitcase
By saying he was signalling to a friend outside
reading.correct: By suggesting he was performing Othello, playing every part himself
reading.explain: He imagines that anyone who saw him could take his throat-grabbing for a one-man rehearsal of Othello.

reading.ru: Один такой тупой-тупой и в телогрейке.
reading.question: How is the first of the two men by the window described?
options: Extremely dull-witted, in a quilted jacket
Extremely clever, in a covert-cloth coat
Old and grey, in a railwayman's uniform
Young and cheerful, in a raincoat
reading.correct: Extremely dull-witted, in a quilted jacket
reading.explain: The pair are drawn as a matched contrast: the dull one in a telogreika, the clever one in a covert-cloth coat.

reading.ru: Не выбегают в тамбур и не заламывают рук.
reading.question: How do the two men by the window drink?
options: Openly, without running out to the vestibule
Hiding the bottle under a coat
Only once the carriage has emptied
reading.correct: Openly, without running out to the vestibule
reading.explain: Unlike Venichka, who hides even from heaven and earth, they pour and drink in full view.

reading.question: What does the clever-looking man say every time he drinks?
options: "Ah, that went down well, the bitch!"
reading.explain: He pronounces the word in a festive voice, while his dull companion praises the vodka and the snack instead.

reading.ru: Мне очень вредит моя деликатность, она исковеркала мне мою юность.
reading.question: What does Venichka blame for wrecking his youth?
reading.explain: He corrects himself a moment later: it is not really delicacy but the fact that he has stretched the sphere of the intimate without limit.

reading.ru: Помню, лет десять тому назад я поселился в Орехово-Зуеве.
reading.question: Where did Venichka settle about ten years earlier?
reading.explain: The story of the four roommates begins with his moving to Orekhovo-Zuevo ten years before.

reading.ru: Мы жили душа в душу, и ссор не было никаких.
reading.question: How did Venichka and his roommates get on at first?
options: In perfect harmony, with no quarrels at all
Each keeping strictly to his own corner
reading.correct: In perfect harmony, with no quarrels at all
reading.explain: If one of them wanted port wine or beer, the rest all wanted the same — until they began to shun him.

reading.question: What was Venichka doing on the evening he understood what was wrong?
reading.explain: He had drunk some beer, grown melancholy and not got up all day, and that is when the four gathered round him.

reading.question: What do the roommates ask Venichka at the very end of the chapter?
options: Whether he drank beer that day
Whether he has any money left
Where he had been all evening
Why he never gets out of bed
reading.correct: Whether he drank beer that day
reading.explain: After accusing him of thinking himself above them, they back the charge up with this question about the beer.

highlight.question: Which sentence compares what was happening inside Venichka to a volcanic eruption and a holiday salute?
sentences: И до самого Карачарова, от Серпа и Молота до Карачарова, мой Бог не мог расслышать мою мольбу, – выпитый стакан то клубился где-то между чревом и пищеводом, то взметался вверх, то снова опадал.
Это было как Везувий, Геркуланум и Помпея, как первомайский салют в столице моей страны.
И я страдал и молился.
highlight.explain: The middle sentence supplies the images of Vesuvius, Herculaneum, Pompeii and the May Day salute.

highlight.question: Which sentence gives Venichka's reason for not giving nature her gifts back?
sentences: И вот только у Карачарова мой Бог расслышал и внял.
Все улеглось и притихло.
А уж если у меня что-нибудь притихнет и уляжется, так это бесповоротно.
Будьте уверены.
Я уважаю природу, было бы некрасиво возвращать природе ее дары…
Да.
highlight.explain: Only the fifth sentence states the reason — his respect for nature.

highlight.question: Which sentence says that these eyes will not blink whatever happens to his country?
sentences: Зато у моего народа – какие глаза!
Они постоянно навыкате, но – никакого напряжения в них.
Полное отсутствие всякого смысла – но зато какая мощь! (Какая духовная мощь!)
Эти глаза не продадут.
Ничего не продадут и ничего не купят.
Что бы ни случилось с моей страной, во дни сомнений, во дни тягостных раздумий, в годину любых испытаний и бедствий – эти глаза не сморгнут.
Им все божья роса…
highlight.explain: The long sixth sentence lists the trials the country may face and says the eyes will not blink at any of them.

highlight.question: Which sentence names the one thing that worries Venichka about the passengers?
sentences: Мне нравится мой народ.
Я счастлив, что родился и возмужал под взглядами этих глаз.
Плохо только вот что: вдруг да они заметили, что я сейчас там на площадке выделывал?..
Кувыркался из угла в угол, как великий трагик Федор Шаляпин, с рукою на горле, как будто меня что душило?
highlight.explain: The third sentence introduces his fear that they may have noticed what he was up to out on the platform.

highlight.question: Which sentence describes the clothing of the second, clever-looking man?
sentences: Вон – справа, у окошка – сидят двое.
Один такой тупой-тупой и в телогрейке.
А другой такой умный-умный и в коверкотовом пальто.
И пожалуйста – никого не стыдятся, наливают и пьют.
Закусывают и тут же опять наливают.
Не выбегают в тамбур и не заламывают рук.
highlight.explain: The third sentence puts the clever one in a covert-cloth coat, as against the quilted jacket of the first.

highlight.question: Which sentence says how many people were already living in the room when Venichka moved in?
sentences: Вот сейчас я вам расскажу.
Помню, лет десять тому назад я поселился в Орехово-Зуеве.
К тому времени, как я поселился, в моей комнате уже жило четверо, я стал у них пятым.
Мы жили душа в душу, и ссор не было никаких.
highlight.explain: The third sentence says four people were already there and that he became the fifth.
